historical_cutoff.rule: completion of final scheduled game of Week 2

methodology.purpose: Current-week context analysis only for the locked Stage 2 Context Candidate Set.

records.current_week_context: Full practice; SF is a difficult defensive environment and Arizona remains heavily concentrated through McBride.
records.implications_for_final_selection: SF matchup vs concentrated ARI offense.

records.current_week_context: Healthy and efficient to start, but Jacksonville's protection struggled last week and New England presents a strong defensive test.
records.implications_for_final_selection: Strong start offset by protection/NE defense.

records.current_week_context: Healthy and coming off 327 yards/4 TD, but Denver has been efficient against the pass and Puka Nacua is expected to remain out.
records.implications_for_final_selection: Strong recent production; tougher DEN defense; Nacua absent.

records.current_week_context: League-leading 662 passing yards after two games and strong performance under pressure; Las Vegas generates pressure but its early defensive sample is limited.
records.implications_for_final_selection: Elite early volume/form; pressure is the main counter-signal.

records.current_week_context: Healthy with 212 rushing yards and four TDs; Dallas is allowing 173.5 rushing yards/game.
records.implications_for_final_selection: Heavy workload plus favorable DAL run environment.

records.current_week_context: Clear lead back after 21 carries/135 yards, but the Chargers have allowed only three explosive runs and rank fifth in defensive EPA/play against the run.
records.implications_for_final_selection: Excellent workload; tougher run matchup.

records.current_week_context: Top Dallas ball carrier, but Baltimore has allowed 83.5 rushing yards/game and ranks fifth in rush defense.
records.implications_for_final_selection: Role is strong; opponent is a major resistance.

records.current_week_context: 45.5% snap share, 44.4% rushing-attempt share and 37.1% route share last week; Indianapolis has allowed the third-highest explosive-run rate.
records.implications_for_final_selection: Role plus favorable IND run defense.

records.current_week_context: Role destabilized after Week 2 fumble: 35.8% snaps versus Henderson's 60.4%. Jacksonville matchup is favorable, but workload is uncertain.
records.implications_for_final_selection: Current backfield role is the dominant concern.

records.current_week_context: Handled 60.4% of snaps and 57.1% of rush attempts in Week 2; Jacksonville matchup is favorable, but Stevenson remains a competing back.
records.implications_for_final_selection: Strong recent usage, unresolved committee risk.

records.current_week_context: Passing-down role is established at 46.3% route share/11.6% target share and a trailing script could help; Croskey-Merritt remains ahead on Washington's depth chart.
records.implications_for_final_selection: Receiving role supportive; rushing volume less secure.

records.current_week_context: 10 targets and 95 yards in Week 2 establish volume, but Pittsburgh has been a strong pass-defense environment.
records.implications_for_final_selection: Volume positive; PIT matchup negative.

records.current_week_context: Only 17.3% target share and described as Cleveland's third passing option, with no red-zone/deep targets.
records.implications_for_final_selection: Low-leverage role is the main issue.

records.current_week_context: Healthy but held without a catch on one target in Week 2 after leading Denver in Week 1; complementary role remains volatile.
records.implications_for_final_selection: Role volatility dominates.

records.current_week_context: Cleared to play and Seattle restores Sam Darnold; Washington weather/defensive conditions add uncertainty.
records.implications_for_final_selection: Availability positive; QB/weather introduce uncertainty.

records.current_week_context: Route share rose to 52% with 18.2% target share and 80 yards last week; Arizona has allowed strong TE efficiency.
records.implications_for_final_selection: Workload ramp plus favorable TE matchup.

records.current_week_context: Healthy but only two targets for 35 yards in Week 2 after no Week 1 targets; Tennessee's passing game remains low-volume.
records.implications_for_final_selection: Target-floor concern despite NYG matchup.

records.current_week_context: Only 13.5% target share and 0.96 YPRR, with no red-zone/deep targets; current role is low leverage.
records.implications_for_final_selection: Low-leverage role and struggling TEN passing offense.

records.current_week_context: 21.7% target share with four red-zone and three deep targets, but Seattle has limited receiver efficiency; Marcus Mariota replaces Jayden Daniels.
records.implications_for_final_selection: Established volume offset by QB/defense/weather.

records.current_week_context: Under 50 yards in both games; Seattle has allowed very low perimeter-receiver efficiency, and Washington changes QBs to Marcus Mariota.
records.implications_for_final_selection: Slow start plus strong SEA coverage and QB change.

records.current_week_context: Arizona's focal point with 17 receptions/23 targets and a TD in each game; role concentration remains strong despite SF defense.
records.implications_for_final_selection: Elite current role concentration.

records.current_week_context: Only one target and zero catches in Week 2; current Browns reporting indicates Denzel Boston has emerged as WR1.
records.implications_for_final_selection: Current target role materially reduced.

records.current_week_context: Healthy after full practice, but only 5.8% target share and 1.55 YPRR against a strong New England perimeter defense.
records.implications_for_final_selection: Healthy but very low current involvement.

records.current_week_context: Cleared to return after missing Week 2 for personal reasons, but current reporting does not show an established high-volume role.
records.implications_for_final_selection: Availability restored; role/volume remains unclear.

records.current_week_context: Primary Saints receiving TE with 7 targets in Week 1 and 4-for-66 in Week 2; four red-zone targets through two games.
records.implications_for_final_selection: Primary role and high-leverage usage.

records.current_week_context: Giants change QBs to Jameis Winston and are expected to lean more run-heavy; rain/wind is also forecast at MetLife.
records.implications_for_final_selection: QB change, script and weather all reduce confidence.

records.current_week_context: Only 13.5% target share and 0.96 YPRR, with no red-zone/deep targets; current role is low leverage.
records.implications_for_final_selection: Low-leverage role and struggling TEN passing offense.
